issue.title: Support Bearer Authentication
issue.body: Bearer is a form of HTTP authentication through a header value (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). It is pretty common and pretty well defined (by [RFC 6750](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6750)) so personally I'd say we should support it out of the box.
